response.overview: A blind couple had constant disagreements over childbearing issues. The blind husband hoped that his half-blind wife would give birth to a child for him, but the wife was also facing the problem of being completely blind and worried that the child would also be blind at birth and the two would be unable to raise them. However, the husband didn't know anything about it, and the husband who was eager to have a child did not hesitate to tamper with the condom. The depression brought by life made the contradiction between the two deepened day by day. Suddenly one day his wife vomited, and this sudden vomiting brought the relationship between the two of them to another turning point.
response.title: Brown Night
